hotel.name: The St. Regis Costa Mujeres Resort, Cancun

verified_facts.text: The resort is a beachfront resort in Costa Mujeres, about 30 minutes north of Cancun Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just 30 minutes north of Cancun Airport, our Costa Mujeres beachfront resort captures the spirit of Quintana Roo

verified_facts.text: Cancun International Airport is about 26.9 km from the property.
verified_facts.excerpt: The closest airport near The St. Regis Costa Mujeres Resort, Cancun is Cancun International Airport (CUN). CUN is located approximately 26.9 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: The resort was designed by the firm Sordo Madaleno and reimagines Mayan legends in stone, wood and metal.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by award-winning firm Sordo Madaleno, the resort reimagines Mayan legends in stone, wood, and metal

verified_facts.text: Every room and suite has a private terrace, with views of sunrise over the sea and sunset behind the mangroves of Isla Blanca.
verified_facts.excerpt: each with private terraces, guests witness the sun rise over the sea and set behind the mangroves of Isla Blanca

verified_facts.text: Some suites have private pools overlooking the Mesoamerican Barrier Reef and the mangrove reserve near Isla Blanca.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience total privacy in suites with private pools overlooking the Mesoamerican Barrier Reef and the sprawling mangrove reserve near Isla Blanca.

verified_facts.text: Suites feature astrological motifs brought to life through light and custom fixtures.
verified_facts.excerpt: In our suites, astrological motifs come to life through a delicate play of light and custom fixtures.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have marble bathrooms with soaking tubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Marble bathrooms with soaking tubs.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers ancestral Mayan treatments and rituals inspired by the sea and the legacy of El Meco.
verified_facts.excerpt: invites guests to to discover ancestral Mayan treatments and rituals inspired by the sea and and the legacy of El Meco

verified_facts.text: There is a kids' swimming pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kids' Swimming Pool

verified_facts.text: Cabanas are available on the beach and by the pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in beachfront cabanas or take in endless views from the infinity pool

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Family Traditions program runs at the resort's Explorer's Club, a complimentary kids club.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Family Traditions signature St. Regis program offers travelers of all ages the opportunity to explore the destination and celebrate the art of play at our Explorer's Club.

verified_facts.text: St. Regis Butler service is available in all accommodations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Available in all accommodations.

verified_facts.text: Each evening butlers open bottles of Champagne with sabers to mark the transition from day to night.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join our Butlers in celebrating the transition from day to night, where bottles of Champagne are opened with regal sabers

verified_facts.text: The resort has five restaurants: Costa Coral, Fish Market, Palmare Grill, The St. Regis Bar and Olivia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Costa CoralFish MarketPalmare Grill The St. Regis BarOlivia

verified_facts.text: Costa Coral serves Mexican cuisine rooted in the biodiversity of the milpa and is open for breakfast and dinner.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Rooted in Mexico's rich culinary legacy and the biodiversity of the milpa, we elevate luxury dining in Cancun.

Open for breakfast and dinner

verified_facts.text: Fish Market is a seafood restaurant with a raw bar, ceviches and shared rice dishes.
verified_facts.excerpt: From the precision of our raw bar to signature ceviches and shared rice compositions, our seafood restaurant in Costa Mujeres honors the integrity of local produce.

verified_facts.text: Palmare Grill is an oceanfront restaurant serving artisanal breads, sun-seared meats and coastal dishes made for sharing.
verified_facts.excerpt: our oceanfront restaurant in Costa Mujeres serves artisanal breads, sun-seared meats, and coastal favorites crafted with local ingredients and designed for effortless sharing

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Bar sits next to the Agave Library, a communal immersive bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: adjacent to the Agave Library, a communal immersive bar

verified_facts.text: Olivia is a specialty coffee spot showcasing Mexican coffees with an artisanal bakery selection.
verified_facts.excerpt: An elevated specialty coffee hub, where each cup becomes a refined daily ritual showcasing premium Mexican coffees, artisanal brewing techniques, complemented by an artisanal bakery selection

verified_facts.text: The resort offers a take on Mrs. Astor's high tea ritual.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience an inspired take on Mrs. Astor's high tea ritual

verified_facts.text: Guests can explore nearby reefs by boat.
verified_facts.excerpt: invite you to explore nearby reefs by boat

verified_facts.text: Valet parking is complimentary for guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Valet parking is complimentary for guests.

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome, one per room, up to 18 kg.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, pets are welcome at The St. Regis Costa Mujeres Resort, Cancun. One pet is allowed per room, with a maximum weight of 18.0 kgs.

verified_facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

verified_facts.text: Breakfast is served at Costa Coral for a fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, breakfast is available onsite at Costa Coral for a fee.

verified_facts.text: The resort is next to The Residences at The St. Regis Costa Mujeres Resort, a development of private residences.
verified_facts.excerpt: An exceptional opportunity awaits at The Residences at The St. Regis Costa Mujeres Resort.
